utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Can I please honk at the break?

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Okay, honk at the break. Drive, Austin. I don't want to make this too long. Put it in drive. Okay. There's a car coming, moving around. Just drive slow. Okay, you're fine.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Okay, you can make the turn. Make the turn, Austin. You have to give a little gas.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Not too much. That's enough. That's enough. Austin, slow down. Slow down, Austin.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Don't freak out too much. You're acting like I'm trying to win a race or something.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I am not 'freaking out.' I am trying to keep us alive. You think this is a game, and it’s very disrespectful when you roll your eyes at my instructions.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I wasn't rolling my eyes, I was just checking the mirrors! Relax.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Don't tell me to relax while you're speeding! Okay, okay, Austin. Okay, stop. Put on the brakes now. Put on the brakes.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Put on the brakes! Austin, put on the brakes.
